title: Доктор Сламп: Космические приключения
alt: Доктор Сламп: Космические приключения Dr. Slump: Hoyoyo! Space Adventure Dr.スランプ “ほよよ!”宇宙大冒険
description: When local teacher Midori Yamabuki receives an emergency summons to her home planet it turns out to be a trap devised by galactic warlord Dr. Mashirito, and it's up to Dr. Senbei Norimaki and a group of students (including his robot daughter Arale) to venture into space to save her. (Source: Anime News Network)

en:
When local teacher Midori Yamabuki receives an emergency summons to her home planet it turns out to be a trap devised by galactic warlord Dr. Mashirito, and it's up to Dr. Senbei Norimaki and a group of students (including his robot daughter Arale) to venture into space to save her.





(Source: Anime News Network)
